svg.aria-label: One request to the model has three parts: the instructions in the system field, the same bytes every request; the conversation so far, sent as it stands and growing, which opens with your first prompt and then up to eight facts, each a user message of its own (where you are working, skills you can open, environment, what is answering, what you have, your request, permissions, waiting questions), told once and then again as a short change note when one changes, and all restated after a compaction, your request word for word, followed by the model's answers, tool calls and results and later prompts; and one schema for each tool advertised, sent every request.
